name: How can I prevent hard water stains from forming on my new fixtures?

mainEntity.name: How can I prevent hard water stains from forming on my new fixtures?

acceptedAnswer.text: Preventing hard water stains involves regular maintenance. Wiping down fixtures after each use to remove standing water is highly effective. You can also apply a protective wax or sealant designed for bathroom fixtures. For a more comprehensive solution, consider installing a water softener system for your home, which removes the minerals from the water before they reach your plumbing.
acceptedAnswer.description: Prevent stains by wiping fixtures dry after use, applying protective sealants, or installing a whole-home water softener system.
